_about: Example Config values for a freelancer (developer / designer / consultant). Copy the keys below into the Config node, replacing the existing ones. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
instructions: Classify this email received in the Gmail inbox of a freelance web developer into exactly one category. Decide by what the email is about and why it was sent, not only by who sent it.

categories.name: Clients
categories.criteria: Messages from or about current clients and their projects: requests, feedback, approvals, meeting notes, shared files, and project-tool notifications (e.g. Jira, Trello, Figma comments) for client work

categories.name: Leads
categories.criteria: Possible new work from people who are not clients yet: contact-form submissions, quote requests, introductions, invitations and proposals on freelance platforms. Job-board newsletters are NOT here.

categories.name: Invoices & Payments
categories.criteria: Money for the user's work: invoices the user issued, payment confirmations from clients, payouts from freelance platforms or payment processors (e.g. Stripe, PayPal), overdue-payment reminders

categories.name: Tools & Subscriptions
categories.criteria: Transactional messages about the user's own software accounts: receipts, renewals, plan changes, usage limits and billing problems for hosting, domains and SaaS tools. Not newsletters or product announcements.

categories.name: Servers & Monitoring
categories.criteria: Automated technical alerts: uptime monitors, CI/CD build results, error trackers, server and backup reports, domain or SSL certificate expiry warnings

categories.name: Security
categories.criteria: 2FA/OTP codes, password resets, new sign-in alerts, account verification, leaked secret or security incident alerts, suspicious activity

categories.name: Tax & Admin
categories.criteria: Accountant, tax office, business registration, insurance, contracts and other paperwork for the user's business

categories.name: Newsletters & Promotions
categories.criteria: Bulk mail from ANY company or person: newsletters, digests, product updates and "what's new" announcements, discounts, webinar and conference marketing, job-board newsletters

categories.name: Social
categories.criteria: Social networks and communities: LinkedIn (including job alerts), X/Twitter, GitHub discussions and mentions, forum replies, Discord or Slack email notifications

categories.name: Personal
categories.criteria: Friends and family, personal purchases and deliveries, travel, appointments and anything private that is not about work

categories.name: Other
categories.criteria: Emails that do not clearly fit any other category
